provenance: Larry's son's written report, sent to the archive on the evening of 2026-09-05, answering the archive's questions about what Larry said at the table while drawing that afternoon. His son listened and did not take notes, so this is his summary from memory in his own words, not Larry's words.
text: On the Fort box, he did mention Captain Kennedy slept there and sometimes he would.
researchNotes: Said at the FORT box of VD-0002. It agrees with the French fort as his radio position (VN-0009, 'my radio was outside') and adds that the fort was where Captain Kennedy slept and where Larry sometimes slept. To be validated in his own words by asking who slept in the fort, without naming anyone. Ledger #35.
